# Design Earthquakes

```{r}
#| include: true
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "report.R"))
Standard.target <- c("GISTM", "CDA", "ANCOLD")
```

## Site-Response {#sec-site-response}

{{< include /_chapters/site.amplification.md >}}

{{< include /_chapters/site.uncertainty.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/PGA.qmd",
    stem = "site-pga",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "site PGA"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/PGA.TR.qmd",
    stem = "site-pga-tr",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "site PGA by return period and condition"
  )
}
rm(i)
```

```{r}

  rm(NOTE)
}
```

## Seismic Design Criteria for Slopes {#sec-criteria}

{{< include /_chapters/deq.criteria.md >}}

{{< include /_chapters/deq.kmax.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/DEQ.operation.qmd",
    stem = "criteria-obe-table",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "tailings operational criteria table"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/DEQ.PGA.qmd",
    stem = "criteria-obe-pga",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(
      ID.target = ID.gmdp,
      Standard.target = "GISTM",
      Stage.target = "Operation"
    ),
    root = root,
    context = "GISTM design PGA by site condition table"
  )
}
rm(i)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/DEQ.closure.qmd",
    stem = "criteria-sse-table",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "tailings closure criteria table"
  )
}
rm(i)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/DEQ.postclosure.qmd",
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (nrow(SiteTable)) {
  NOTE <- .deckNote("sdc", "Seismic Design Criteria", "The design criteria by standard and consequence classification are developed in the %s annex.")
  if (nzchar(NOTE)) cat("\n\n", NOTE, "\n\n", sep = "")
  rm(NOTE)
}
```
